summary: Iteration 9 — ROSY/RUMATKU simplification: verified mock integrations, auto employee-sync on period create, read-only Karyawan/Absensi, Ambil Data Absensi flow, overtime from logs, removal of schedules/rotations/attendance CRUD, nav cleanup. Backend 93/93 pass. Frontend full flow verified via Playwright (manager login → create TEST_UI April 2026 period → 3 employees synced → fetch-attendance → 90 logs → Budi THP Rp 7.974.276 → review page shows read-only earn-overtime row → delete period). Removed/obsolete tests cleaned up (test_schedules.py, test_rotations_and_import.py, test_shift_recap.py deleted; TestAttendance / test_attendance_today_shape / TestUnitMingguSchedule / NPWP PUT / overtime-editable asserts replaced). All TEST_ periods and non-March attendance logs purged after run; Maret 2026 approved period + Budi's 18 March logs preserved.

issues: Radix Dialog warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' (accessibility nit)

action_items: (nit) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to create-period-dialog and reject-dialog to clear Radix a11y warning.
(nit) IntegrationBadge returns null until /api/hr/integrations resolves; could render skeleton to avoid layout shift on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_hr.fetch_attendance deletes logs by (employee_id IN by_nik, work_date range) — correct scoping. However, if ROSY sync later renames an employee's NIK, old by_nik → employee_id mapping would strand prior logs; low risk given mock dataset.

integrations._mock_rumatku: when start.startswith('2026-03') it returns ONLY Budi (EMP-001) rows — intentional per spec. unknown_niks returned = [] (never populated) because Siti/Dimas simply get no rows in the response rather than being flagged. Spec says 'returns logs/processed/unknown_niks' so returning [] is correct.

pipeline.build_slip now overrides adj['overtime_hours'] with sum of log.overtime_hours. This means any manual save-draft payload that includes overtime_hours is silently ignored. UI already hides the input (Workbench) — consistent.
sync_employees upserts users by email idempotently; good. Password hash is random secrets.token_urlsafe(16) — only used for new users (employee login still works via existing seeded passwords).

routes_recap.shift_recap counts 'present_no_shift' only when log.shift_code is empty — spec's 'Masuk Tanpa Shift' column matches. 'Libur (day_off)' uses leave_type == 'day_off' OR is_off_day. 'Tanpa Log' = days_in_month − len(mine). Looks correct.

No endpoint restricts fetch-attendance to a specific status window beyond EDITABLE_STATUSES — approve-all can therefore still mutate attendance_count field in payroll_periods via re-run on draft/revision only; good.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (replaced obsolete overtime-editable tests + attendance CRUD + attendance/today)
seed_data_creation: Playwright created TEST_UI_<ts> period and deleted it afterwards. Backend tests created TEST_Iter9 Apr Sync / Apr Fetch / Mar Fetch periods — all auto-deleted in fixtures. Final DB cleanup: 6 TEST periods purged, 90 orphan non-March attendance logs purged. Remaining: Maret 2026 (approved) + 3 real employees + 18 Budi March logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: 93 total across 6 files. New iter9 test file is test_iter9_integrations.py (TestIntegrations/TestCreatePeriodSyncsEmployees/TestFetchAttendance/TestRemovedEndpoints/TestShiftRecapFromLogs). Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -n0 -v` (29s). Mocked flows: ROSY → EMPLOYEES seed list; RUMATKU → _mock_rumatku(start,end,employees): special-cases 2026-03-* to return BUDI_MARCH dataset only, otherwise generates present-day entries for every employee with Sun as day_off and deterministic late/early/overtime via SHA1(nik+date). overtime_hours now sourced from logs only (adj.overtime_hours ignored by build_slip). Approved periods cannot re-fetch attendance (400). Removed endpoints: POST/PUT/DELETE /hr/employees, POST/DELETE /hr/attendance, /hr/attendance/import*, /hr/schedules, /hr/shift-rotations, /v1/employee/attendance/*.
rca of the issue: No defects detected. Pre-existing obsolete tests (overtime-editable preview/save-draft assertions in backend_test.py) correctly failed against new 'overtime from logs read-only' behavior and were updated. Pre-existing YTD cleanup race in test_tax_and_bsi (xdist LoadScope split class vs module tests across workers) made tolerant to 404 — not a bug, just test infra. Minor Radix a11y console warning on Dialog components (missing aria-describedby) — cosmetic only.
